subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
10. The method suggested by first team member according to which, a series of
instructions and/or questions which a member of the auditing staff must
follow and/or answer. When he completes instruction, he initials the space
against the instruction. This method is called as
(A)  Flow Chart
(B)  Check List
(C)  Narrative Record
(D)  Questionnaire
(2 Marks)
